title: Deluxe Induction Service Tool
lead: A new Deluxe Induction Tool with a cone adapter, giving technicians more service port options.
body: The cone adapter is for vehicles with no vacuum hose connection near the throttle body: use it in the MAP sensor location to perform the service. The tool makes for a quick, reliable induction cleaning service. Both adapters are included.
source: TSB Vol 24 No 4 - 2024 New Induction Tool.pdf
